verdictStatement: REJECT. Three MUST-FIX, two SHOULD-FIX. The candidate's byte work is clean and its central act is warranted: every cited digest recomputes exactly, all nine pinned decision commits resolve to their claimed headings, the four D-346 copies exist and are byte-identical to the D-297 implementation across exactly the four G10-quoted platforms with G23 ORDERED-EQUAL, and remasuring leftover-design of those four copies to stale as an authoring claim is precisely the act live D-346 reserved for a leftover-join remasurement succeeding leftover-join.v11 of sarif. leftover-design of OBL-FC-OUTFAIL-FX is correctly held open on FC-OUTFAIL.committed-run-preserved under the section 7.1 RunId park, no SATISFIED is claimed, no deictic appears, and all 132 leftover-join.vN tokens are lineage-qualified. What fails is the succession sweep. The candidate advanced its own head node and its lastHeadingCustody disposition to D-346 but left seven basedOn roles asserting that last-heading custody remains D-344, so the artifact resolves the same live fact eight times and gets it wrong seven (MF-1). It installed basedOn.predecessorV11 naming leftover-join.v11 of sarif as the current recorded DR-122 leftover remasurement but left basedOn.predecessorV7 and basedOn.predecessorV4 asserting that leftover-join.v7 of sarif holds that standing "until a recordable successor is adopted", a condition D-345 already discharged (MF-2). And it added basedOn.goldenOutfailV5 without demoting basedOn.goldenOutfailV3, which still calls that golden "Current" where the D-346 entry it pins calls it the D-297 historical first-authoring twice over, and which the artifact itself knows how to fix because it applies the correct demotion to the structurally identical goldenNonauthV3 node (MF-3). All three are the same failure: a predecessor value carried forward past the recording that superseded it, and the subject's own findingDisposition.codexV8 records that two of these exact node classes were MUST-FIX at leftover-join.v8 of sarif. Under ACCEPT only at 0 MUST-FIX and 0 SHOULD-FIX, the verdict is REJECT.
